title: File:19th-century Ramayana manuscript, Ramakien, Thailand version, Khom script, Hanuman with sword reaches Ravana's palace.jpg
author: Ms Sarah Welch
description: The Ramayana is a Sanskrit language Hindu epic attributed to Valmiki, whose first redaction is dated between 5th-century to 4th-century BCE (see J. L. Brockington        Academic The Sanskrit Epics, p. 379  ISBN:  90-04-10260-4. [dead link]). The text has been popular on the Indian subcontinent since the ancient times. It arrived in southeast Asia about mid 1st-millennium CE, and has been popular
